name: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc.
tagline: Leading OTC health and personal care brand portfolio with strong retail distribution

ranks.global_us: Top player in OTC health and personal care
ranks.subsector: Leading in nasal care and consumer health brands

hero_kpi_rationale: Flux de trésorerie d'exploitation stable et robuste de 251.5 M$ en 2025, démontrant la génération de cash cohérente du modèle OTC avec levier de marque établi et distribution retail forte

kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business operations before capital expenditures and financing activities.
kpis.signal: Stable operational cash generation demonstrating business resilience
kpis.description: Net cash provided by operating activities was $251.5 million for 2025 compared to $248.9 million for 2024, representing a $2.6 million increase driven by improved net income before non-cash items.

kpis.explanation: Cash spent each year for new equipment, facility improvements, or manufacturing infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Lower investing activities reflect modest capex discipline and absence of major acquisitions in 2025
kpis.description: Net cash used in investing activities was $17.5 million for 2025 compared to $20.1 million for 2024, primarily due to a decrease in capital expenditures of $1.3 million. The prior year included a manufacturing acquisition in Australia.

kpis.explanation: Aggregate principal amount of senior notes and term loans outstanding.
kpis.signal: Debt reduction achieved through repayment of 2012 Term Loan in fiscal 2025
kpis.description: As of March 31, 2025, total outstanding indebtedness of $1.0 billion consists of $400.0 million of 5.125% Senior Notes due January 15, 2028 and $600.0 million of 3.750% Senior Notes due April 1, 2031. The 2012 Term Loan was fully repaid and all related commitments terminated during fiscal 2025.

kpis.explanation: Percentage of gross revenues from Walmart and Amazon combined.
kpis.signal: Significant customer concentration risk with top two customers representing one-third of revenues
kpis.description: During 2025, Walmart and Amazon accounted for approximately 19% and 14% of gross revenues respectively, together representing 33% of gross revenues. The company has no long-term agreements with these customers.

kpis.explanation: Undrawn borrowing capacity available under the asset-based lending credit facility.
kpis.signal: Adequate liquidity position with $165.7 million available borrowing capacity
kpis.description: As of March 31, 2025, the company had no balance outstanding on the 2012 ABL Revolver (total capacity $200.0 million, extended to December 8, 2028) and available borrowing capacity of $165.7 million.

kpis.explanation: Research and development spending for brand innovation and new product development.
kpis.description: No specific R&D expenditure data provided in the 10-K. Company focuses on brand reinvigoration, product line extensions, and marketing support rather than new drug development.

kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after cost of goods sold.
kpis.signal: Data not disclosed in extracts provided
kpis.description: Gross margin data not available in the provided 10-K excerpts.

kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Data not disclosed in extracts provided
kpis.description: Operating margin not provided in the available 10-K excerpts.

kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across all operations.
kpis.signal: Employee count not disclosed in provided documents
kpis.description: Headcount information not available in the 10-K excerpts provided.

kpis.explanation: Revenue from subscription or recurring service models.
kpis.signal: Business model is transactional OTC retail, not subscription-based
kpis.description: Not applicable to PBH business model. The company operates on a traditional retail sales model for OTC health and personal care products, not recurring subscription or service revenue.
